notes.title: Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear Players

Gujian2 will be temporarily suspending game services due to server maintenance and upgrade. The maintenance will last from [b]April 17th at 21:30 to April 18th at 01:00 (UTC+8）[/b], during which players will not be able to log in to the games.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this upgrade may cause to our players, and we are grateful for your support and understanding.

Gujian Team

notes.title: 庆“古剑奇谭十二周年”美术集再版上架
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家朋友们：


　　剑鸣一纪，创绘无垠！

　　为庆祝古剑奇谭系列迎来了十二周年，一直备受欢迎的《古剑奇谭二》官方美术设定集再版重新上架啦！现在购买还将随书附赠“网元圣唐品牌狂欢月”相关限量纪念品。

　　同为古剑系列作品的《古剑奇谭三》的官方美术设定集，也已经同期再版上架。大量古剑系列衍生品的优惠折扣活动等您参加！

　　可于淘宝搜索店铺“网元圣唐官方商城 ”了解详情或购买。
	
　　感谢大家的支持与厚爱！

网元圣唐运营团队
2022年7月27日

notes.title: System maintenance announcement on May 12
notes.content:
Dear players:

In order to improve the service quality, Wangyuan's platform center will carry out system upgrade and maintenance from [b]May 12th from 1:00 am to 13:00 pm (UTC+8)[/b].

During the maintenance period, the game functions will be affected and you cannot log in to the game.

If the maintenance content cannot be completed within the scheduled time, we will extend the maintenance time as appropriate and notify players in time.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your patience and understanding!

Happy gaming everyone!


Wangyuan Shengtang Operation Team
May 11, 2022
